readiness_rules: READY only when every dependency command exists and is COMPLETED.
Missing dependency keeps entry WAITING_DEPENDENCY and is a validation error for executable queue state.
A command MUST NOT depend on itself.
Command dependency graph MUST be acyclic.
A command_id may appear at most once in one queue snapshot.
Queue state CLAIMED is informational until P4.4 validates an active lease.
TERMINAL entries are not scheduler candidates.
mutation_rules: Enqueue allocates a monotonic enqueue_sequence supplied by the queue authority; wall-clock time is not an ordering authority.
Queue reordering cannot bypass dependency readiness.
Priority changes are explicit queue mutations and do not alter command history.
Queue storage does not grant command execution permission.
